title: Every absolutely simple Lie algebra of type E8, F4 or G2 over Q is R-universal
author: Dave Witte Morris
work: A Cohomological Proof that Real Representations of Semisimple Lie Algebras Have Q-Forms
source_version: Official SIGMA 11 (2015) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2015.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the exhaustiveness of the exceptional types (author lemma at source lines 501-504, label EFGAllUniv): every absolutely simple Lie algebra of type E8, F4 or G2 over Q is R-universal. The proof (source lines 506-512) is short but it is the case that closes the author's classification, and it works precisely because these three types have no outer automorphisms and trivial centre, which makes the star-action trivial (proof lines 507-509); the author then reads off from the earlier remark on the root-lattice case that the Tits algebras are split and concludes with the division-algebra description of R-universality (proof lines 509-512). The author calls the remaining types very easy to deal with immediately before the statement, and the card keeps that level of detail. H2.
